title: Flare Configuration
description: Configuration file for a Flare application (flare.json).

env.description: Current runtime environment name. Influences log format and other environment-specific defaults.

host.description: HTTP listen hostname or IP address.

shutdownTimeout.description: Graceful shutdown timeout in milliseconds. The server stops accepting new connections and waits up to this long for in-flight requests to complete.

maxBodyBytes.description: Global default maximum request body size in bytes. Can be overridden per-route via the route contract's maxBodyBytes field.

requestIdHeader.description: When true (default), Flare emits an X-Request-Id header on every response.

requestTiming.description: When true, Flare captures Date.now() at request start and exposes it as request.startTime.

keepAliveTimeout.description: Server-level keep-alive timeout in milliseconds. Should exceed your load balancer's idle timeout to avoid 502/504 races.

headersTimeout.description: Maximum time in milliseconds the server waits for complete HTTP request headers.

requestTimeout.description: Maximum time in milliseconds for an entire request (headers + body). Set to 0 to disable.

level.description: Minimum log level to emit across all transports. Per-transport overrides take precedence.

format.description: Default log output format. Defaults to "pretty" when host.env is "development", otherwise "json".

enableContext.description: When true, the logger uses AsyncLocalStorage to attach request context (source, requestId) to every log record emitted inside a request.

transports.description: Per-transport configuration keyed by the transport's static transportName.

level.description: Minimum log level for this transport. Overrides the top-level log.level for this transport only.
